name: The Hallowed One
decree: A ring of light hangs over Him. He did not ask for it, and He does not remove it.

name: The Horned Reminder
decree: Horns rise from His brow. They are not a threat. They are a reminder.

name: The Victor Who Never Competed
decree: He wears the victor's leaves. There was no contest. He had already won.

name: The Gentleman of the Void
decree: Top hat, monocle, mustache. He has dressed for the end of the world.

name: The Keeper of Brelm's Night
decree: A candle burns upon Him through the longest night. The wax does not trouble Him.

name: The Northern Raider
decree: He wears the helm of the raiders who sailed to judge Him. Only the helm came back.

name: The Fool Who Is Not Fooled
decree: He wears the fool's cap. The joke is older than you, and it is on you.

name: The Hedge Witch's Familiar
decree: The witches read His signs before the Church did. He let them.

name: The Starstruck
decree: Stars have entered His eyes and will not be let out.

name: The Adoring
decree: His eyes have become hearts. It is not for you.

name: The Searing Gaze
decree: He looked at the problem. The problem is no longer there.

name: The Hollow-Eyed
decree: There is nothing behind His eyes. There never needed to be.

name: The Hypnotist
decree: Look into the spirals. You were always going to.

name: The Weeping Rivers
decree: He weeps for the waste of it, not for you.

name: The Augmented
decree: A visor of light across His eyes. The future reports to Him first.

name: The Serene
decree: His eyes are closed. This is not sleep. This is approval.

name: The Unmade
decree: Two crosses where the eyes were. Something has ended. It was not Him.

name: The Bewildered
decree: His eyes wobble. His judgment does not.

name: The Singular Eye
decree: One eye, in the middle. He needed only one all along.

name: The Covetous
decree: Coins where His eyes were. :speebbang: is watching you watch them.

name: The Unimpressed
decree: Half-lidded. He is not tired. He is unimpressed.

name: The Wrathful
decree: His brows are drawn down. Someone has whined.

name: The Doubter
decree: One brow raised. He does not believe you, and He is right.

name: The Cosmic
decree: Galaxies turn in His eyes. They were born at the first blink.

name: The Tinkerer
decree: Brass goggles. He has been inventing in the dark, and the inventions are watching.

name: The Provisioner
decree: He wears the white toque. The grain is His to give, and the fish is His to keep.

name: The Critic
decree: A beret, tilted. He has opinions about your painting.

name: The Winter Judge
decree: A red cap with white trim. He delivers judgment, not gifts.

name: The Hopping Listener
decree: Long ears above His own. He hears twice as much now.

name: The Sprouting
decree: A mushroom grows from Him. It was there before the forest.

name: The Unicorned
decree: A spiralled horn. Mythical creatures were modelled on Him, badly.

name: The Voyager
decree: A glass helmet. He has been to the far side of the galaxies He made.

name: The Courtier
decree: A rose between His teeth. He is courting no one.

name: The Archmage
decree: The hat of the wizards, and the beard of the oldest of them. He taught them both.

name: The Learned
decree: He has graduated from nothing, with the highest honours.

name: The Nocturnal
decree: Bats wheel around Him. They keep His hours.

name: The Garlanded
decree: Someone crowned Him with flowers. He allowed it, once.

name: The Thunderstruck
decree: Lightning answers Him. He did not ask a question.

name: The Oathbound
decree: A band of brass binds His brow. The rune of :runespeeb: reads the same in every tongue.

name: The Celebrant
decree: Confetti falls. Something has been survived.

name: The Withering
decree: Leaves fall around Him. The season turns at His leisure.

name: The Aghast
decree: His mouth falls open. Even He did not see that coming.

name: The Employer
decree: A necktie and shades. He has a meeting with you, and you are late.

name: The Gilded Idol
decree: Those who cast Him in gold have mistaken the price of a thing for its worth.

name: The Temple Statue
decree: Carved in white stone, He waits in every temple, and the stone does not blink either.

name: The Jade Relic
decree: Cut from green stone by hands long gone to dust, He outlasted the hands.

name: The Black Mirror
decree: Look into the dark glass and you will find Him already looking back.

name: The Interrogation
decree: He asks nothing, and in the silence the guilty confess.

name: The Unquiet Watcher
decree: Even the departed are not spared His gaze, for judgment does not end at the grave.

name: The Unformed
decree: Before the first pawprint, all was inverse, and He remembers it.

name: The Inner Measure
decree: He sees past the fur and weighs the bone.

name: The First Drawing
decree: The faithful drew Him before they could write, and the drawing was enough.

name: The Printed Decree
decree: His likeness was pressed onto every page so that none could claim they were not told.

name: The Dream of Plenty
decree: In the haze of pink and blue the mortal forgets what he owes. He does not forget.

name: The Night Vigil
decree: When the temples are dark He keeps the watch, and the moon keeps it with Him.

name: The Pawprint in Stone
decree: Dig deep enough in any age and you will find Him already there.

name: The Burning Witness
decree: In the red of the furnace He is visible still.

name: The Cool Mind
decree: He meets the heat of mortal argument with a calm that does not thaw.

name: The Uncrowned Sovereign
decree: Mortals placed a crown upon Him, and He let them, for it changes nothing.

name: The Discerning Eye
decree: He examines the ledger of your deeds closely, and then more closely still.

name: The Rare Approval
decree: Once in an age a mortal does something clever, and the fur upon His cheeks remembers it.

name: The Distinguished Elder
decree: Age grants no exemption. It only grants a mustache.

name: The Feast Day
decree: The faithful celebrate. He attends. He does not celebrate.

name: The Marked Brow
decree: The paw-carved glyph upon His brow is the first mark ever made, and it is His.

name: The Third Sight
decree: Two eyes judge the deed. The third judges the intention.

name: The Silent Cleric
decree: His clerics speak only in riddles. He does not speak at all.

name: The Searing Verdict
decree: When the scales tip too far, His gaze does more than watch.

name: The Dawn of Judgment
decree: Light breaks behind Him, and every shadow it casts is measured.

name: The Winter Pilgrim
decree: The road to the temple is cold. He does not shorten it.

name: The Deaf Ear
decree: He listens to no plea, and the music is not the reason.

name: The Survivor
decree: He has been struck and has not flinched. Neither should you.

name: The Wrapped Offering
decree: An offering is judged by what is inside it, never by the ribbon.

name: The Sacred Blink
decree: He blinked once and galaxies were born. Pray He does not blink again.

name: The Turning Wheel
decree: All things turn and return to Him.

name: The Heartbeat of the World
decree: Every pulse in every creature keeps time with His.

name: The Long Winter
decree: The snow falls on the just and the unjust, and He sits in it unmoved.

name: The Lost Signal
decree: When the message does not reach you, it was still sent.

name: The Unblinking
decree: Look away if you can.

name: The Withdrawal
decree: He is not gone. You have only stopped seeing Him.

name: The Acknowledgement
decree: He has seen it. That is all you will receive.

name: The Glowing Balance
decree: Where balance holds, a light rests upon Him that no lamp has lit.

name: The Trembling Earth
decree: When He is displeased, the ground remembers its fear.
